title: Spicy Thai Penne Pasta
description: A Thai-inspired penne pasta dish with a spicy kick, made with a combination of crunchy vegetables and savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Crispy British Hot Chili Peppers
ingredients.notes: depending on desired level of spiciness

instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add British peppercorns and crispy hot chili peppers. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add Thai red curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in Thai coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add cooked penne pasta to the pan and toss to coat with curry sauce.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Optional: serve with additional crispy hot chili peppers on top.
